# Operational metadata evidence

`metric_log_sample.json` is a screened projection of one actual Origo
ClickHouse 25.3.2.39 diagnostic record, retrieved on 2026-09-13. It contains only
its date, timestamp and query counter; no query text, hostname, credentials or
settings were exported. Tests combine that expired record with newly observed
local ClickHouse diagnostics to exercise expiration while preserving recent rows.

Partition/data-version and Arrow tests use the existing genuine Binance spot trade
archives under `tests/fixtures/binance/spot/daily/trades/revisioned`. Minute bars are
computed from those trades. Operational runs, failures and locks are generated by
executing Dagster, not by fabricating market records.

`query_plan_proof.json` records the measured production-scale, read-only query
experiment. The consistent SQLite snapshot was RAM-only and removed after the
experiment. It is supporting evidence, not a substitute for the post-deployment
GraphQL acceptance check.
